q: The second-order channel coding rate for n uses of a channel with capacity C and dispersion V at error ε satisfies:
opts: log M* = nC - √(nV)·Φ⁻¹(ε) + O(log n) where Φ⁻¹ is the inverse Gaussian CDF
exp: Polyanskiy–Poor–Verdú (2010): log M*(n,ε) = nC - √(nV)Φ⁻¹(ε) + O(log n). The √n term shows the 'backoff from capacity' due to finite blocklength — at error ε=0.01 (Φ⁻¹≈2.33), we must reduce the rate by 2.33√(V/n) below capacity.
